title: Parametric Skills
abstract: arXiv:2606.30015v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: For LLMs, skills are textual recipes encoding mature problem-solving experience. Despite widespread deployment, their utility is limited by the model's ability to comprehend and follow skill instructions. To address this limitation, we propose ParametricSkills, a framework that parameterizes textual skills at test time, enabling context-free management of the full skill lifecycle. Specifically, we first construct a large-scale and high-quality skill collection, and then synthesize single-turn and multi-turn skill-exploitation trajectories. Using this data, we then train a hypernetwork that parameterizes both the content and the exploitation methodologies of skills by converting textual skills into LoRA adapters. To facilitate the real-world application of our framework, we further align the hypernetwork on complex, long-horizon trajectories collected with OpenCode, enabling the models to operate reliably in realistic interactive work

translated_abstract: 对于大语言模型（LLMs）而言，技能是编码成熟问题解决经验的文本化“配方”。尽管技能已被广泛部署，但其效用受限于模型理解和遵循技能指令的能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出了ParametricSkills——一个在测试时将文本技能参数化的框架，实现了无需上下文的全技能生命周期管理。具体而言，我们首先构建了一个大规模、高质量的技能集合，随后合成了单轮和多轮的技能利用轨迹。利用这些数据，我们训练了一个超网络，通过将文本技能转换为LoRA适配器，对技能的内容及其利用方法进行参数化。为促进该框架在真实世界中的应用，我们进一步使用从OpenCode收集的复杂、长程轨迹对超网络进行对齐，使模型能够在真实的交互式工作中可靠运行。
tldr: 提出ParametricSkills框架，通过超网络在测试时将文本技能转化为LoRA适配器，实现无需上下文的技能全生命周期管理与利用，并借助真实交互轨迹对齐提升模型在实际工作中的可靠性。
en_tdlr: Proposes ParametricSkills, a framework that parameterizes textual skills at test time via a hypernetwork converting them into LoRA adapters, enabling context-free management of the full skill lifecycle and reliable operation in realistic interactive workflows.
